const STEP_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;

pub(crate) fn parse_document_with_storage(source: &[u8], storage_limit: usize) -> Result<DocumentModel<'_>, DocumentParseError> {
    if storage_limit < size_of::<XmlToken>() {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::ResourceExhausted, diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic::default() });
    }
    if source.len() > vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES {
        return Err(DocumentParseError {
            error: DocumentError::Limit,
            diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic { category: XmlError::InputLimit, offset: vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES },
        });
    }

    let mut stream = XmlTokenStream::new(source, storage_limit).map_err(|_| DocumentParseError {
        error: DocumentError::OutOfMemory,
        diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic::default(),
    })?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
        || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
    {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::OutOfMemory, diagnostic: XmlDiagnostic::default() });
    }
    let status = loop {
        let status = stream.step(STEP_BYTES, false);
        if stream.token_storage_bytes() > storage_limit
            || stream.open_name_storage_bytes() > MAX_OPEN_NAME_BYTES
        {
            return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::OutOfMemory, diagnostic: stream.result().diagnostic });
        }
        if status != StreamStatus::Ok { break status; }
    };
    let result = stream.result();
    if status != StreamStatus::Complete || result.diagnostic.category != XmlError::None {
        let error = match result.diagnostic.category {
            XmlError::InputLimit | XmlError::NodeLimit | XmlError::DepthLimit | XmlError::AttributeLimit
            | XmlError::TextLimit => DocumentError::Limit,
            XmlError::OutputExhausted => DocumentError::ResourceExhausted,
            XmlError::None => DocumentError::OutOfMemory,
            _ => DocumentError::Parse,
        };
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error, diagnostic: result.diagnostic });
    }

    if result.element_count == 0 || result.element_count > MAX_NODES || result.element_count > u32::MAX as usize
        || result.attribute_count > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES
        || checked_table_bytes::<Node>(result.element_count).is_none()
        || checked_table_bytes::<Attribute>(result.attribute_count).is_none()
    {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::Limit, diagnostic: result.diagnostic });
    }
    let tokens = stream.take().ok_or(DocumentParseError {
        error: DocumentError::Parse,
        diagnostic: result.diagnostic,
    })?;
    if stream.token_storage_bytes() != 0 {
        return Err(DocumentParseError { error: DocumentError::Parse, diagnostic: result.diagnostic });
    }

    let id = allocate_document_id().ok_or(DocumentParseError {
        error: DocumentError::IdExhausted,
        diagnostic: result.diagnostic,
    })?;
    let (nodes, attributes, root) = build_tables(source, &tokens, result.element_count, result.attribute_count)
        .map_err(|error| DocumentParseError { error, diagnostic: result.diagnostic })?;
    Ok(DocumentModel::from_parts(source, id, nodes, attributes, Some(root)))
}

fn build_tables(
    source: &[u8],
    tokens: &[XmlToken],
    node_count: usize,
    attribute_count: usize,
) -> Result<(Vec<Node>, Vec<Attribute>, u32), DocumentError> {
    let mut nodes: Vec<Node> = Vec::new();
    nodes.try_reserve_exact(node_count).map_err(|_| DocumentError::OutOfMemory)?;
    if nodes.capacity() > MAX_NODES { return Err(DocumentError::OutOfMemory); }
    let mut attributes: Vec<Attribute> = Vec::new();
    attributes.try_reserve_exact(attribute_count).map_err(|_| DocumentError::OutOfMemory)?;
    if attributes.capacity() > vexel_xml::MAX_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES { return Err(DocumentError::OutOfMemory); }
    let mut stack: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
    stack.try_reserve_exact(MAX_DEPTH).map_err(|_| DocumentError::OutOfMemory)?;
    if stack.capacity() > MAX_DEPTH { return Err(DocumentError::OutOfMemory); }

    let mut root = None;
    let mut index = 0usize;
    while index < tokens.len() {
        let token = tokens[index];
        match token.kind {
            TokenKind::StartElement | TokenKind::EmptyElement => {
                if nodes.len() >= node_count || nodes.len() >= MAX_NODES || nodes.len() >= u32::MAX as usize
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(token.source, source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                }
                let slot = u32::try_from(nodes.len()).map_err(|_| DocumentError::Limit)?;
                let parent = stack.last().copied().unwrap_or(no_slot());
                let depth = stack.len();
                let mut node = Node {
                    name: token.name,
                    source: DocumentSourceSpan { offset: token.source.offset, length: token.source.length },
                    first_attribute: attributes.len(),
                    depth,
                    parent,
                    ..Node::default()
                };
                if parent != no_slot() {
                    let parent_index = parent as usize;
                    let parent_node = nodes.get(parent_index).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                    let previous_last = parent_node.last_child;
                    if parent_node.first_child == no_slot() { nodes[parent_index].first_child = slot; }
                    else {
                        let previous = nodes.get_mut(previous_last as usize).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                        previous.next_sibling = slot;
                    }
                    nodes[parent_index].last_child = slot;
                } else if parent == no_slot() {
                    if root.replace(slot).is_some() { return Err(DocumentError::Parse); }
                } else {
                    return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                }

                index += 1;
                while let Some(attribute) = tokens.get(index).filter(|next| next.kind == TokenKind::Attribute) {
                    if attributes.len() >= attribute_count || attribute.name.slice(source).is_none()
                        || attribute.value.slice(source).is_none() || checked_span(attribute.source, source).is_none()
                    {
                        return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                    }
                    attributes.push(Attribute { name: attribute.name, value: attribute.value });
                    node.attribute_count += 1;
                    index += 1;
                }
                nodes.push(node);
                if token.kind == TokenKind::StartElement {
                    if stack.len() >= MAX_DEPTH { return Err(DocumentError::Limit); }
                    stack.push(slot);
                }
            }
            TokenKind::EndElement => {
                let Some(slot) = stack.pop() else { return Err(DocumentError::Parse); };
                let node = nodes.get_mut(slot as usize).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                let end = token.source.offset.checked_add(token.source.length).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                let node_end = node.source.offset.checked_add(node.source.length).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                if node.source.offset > token.source.offset || end < node_end || end > source.len()
                    || token.name.slice(source).is_none()
                {
                    return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
                }
                node.source.length = end.checked_sub(node.source.offset).ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?;
                index += 1;
            }
            _ => index += 1,
        }
    }
    if !stack.is_empty() || nodes.len() != node_count || attributes.len() != attribute_count {
        return Err(DocumentError::Parse);
    }
    Ok((nodes, attributes, root.ok_or(DocumentError::Parse)?))
}

fn checked_span<'a>(span: XmlSpan, source: &'a [u8]) -> Option<&'a [u8]> {
    let end = span.offset.checked_add(span.length)?;
    source.get(span.offset..end)
}

/// An immutable-source document with safely owned indexes and mutable live
/// state. The source borrow must outlive this model.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct DocumentModel<'source> {
    pub(crate) source: &'source [u8],
    pub(crate) id: u64,
    pub(crate) nodes: Vec<Node>,
    pub(crate) attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
    pub(crate) live_node_count: usize,
    pub(crate) root: Option<u32>,
}

impl<'source> DocumentModel<'source> {
    pub(crate) fn from_parts(
        source: &'source [u8],
        id: u64,
        nodes: Vec<Node>,
        attributes: Vec<Attribute>,
        root: Option<u32>,
    ) -> Self {
        let live_node_count = nodes.len();
        Self { source, id, nodes, attributes, live_node_count, root }
    }

    pub fn document_id(&self) -> u64 { self.id }
    pub fn source(&self) -> &'source [u8] { self.source }
    pub fn node_count(&self) -> usize { self.nodes.len() }
    pub fn live_node_count(&self) -> usize { self.live_node_count }

    pub fn root(&self) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let slot = self.root?;
        self.nodes.get(slot as usize).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(slot))
    }

    pub fn first_child(&self, parent: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(parent)?;
        let mut child = node.first_child;
        while child != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(child as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(child)); }
            child = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn next_sibling(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        let mut sibling = node.next_sibling;
        while sibling != NO_SLOT {
            let current = self.nodes.get(sibling as usize)?;
            if current.live { return Some(self.handle(sibling)); }
            sibling = current.next_sibling;
        }
        None
    }

    pub fn parent(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return None; }
        self.nodes.get(node.parent as usize).filter(|parent| parent.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(node.parent))
    }

    pub fn tag_name(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<&'source [u8]> {
        self.resolve(handle)?.name.slice(self.source)
    }

    pub fn attribute_count(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> usize {
        self.resolve(handle).map_or(0, |node| node.attribute_count)
    }

    pub fn attribute_at(&self, handle: DocumentHandle, index: usize) -> Option<(&'source [u8], &'source [u8])> {
        let node = self.resolve(handle)?;
        if index >= node.attribute_count { return None; }
        let attribute = self.attributes.get(node.first_attribute.checked_add(index)?)?;
        Some((attribute.name.slice(self.source)?, attribute.value.slice(self.source)?))
    }

    pub fn depth(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<usize> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.depth)
    }

    pub fn node_at(&self, slot: usize) -> Option<DocumentHandle> {
        let index = u32::try_from(slot).ok()?;
        self.nodes.get(slot).filter(|node| node.live)?;
        Some(self.handle(index))
    }

    pub fn source_span(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<DocumentSourceSpan> {
        Some(self.resolve(handle)?.source)
    }

    /// Removes a node and all descendants. Slots remain stable; each live
    /// generation advances so previously issued handles cannot resolve.
    pub fn remove_subtree(&mut self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> bool {
        if self.resolve(handle).is_none() { return false; }
        for index in 0..self.nodes.len() {
            if !self.is_descendant_or_self(index, handle.slot as usize) { continue; }
            let node = &mut self.nodes[index];
            if node.live {
                node.live = false;
                self.live_node_count -= 1;
                if node.generation != u32::MAX { node.generation += 1; }
            }
        }
        if self.root == Some(handle.slot) { self.root = None; }
        true
    }

    fn is_descendant_or_self(&self, index: usize, ancestor: usize) -> bool {
        let mut current = index;
        loop {
            if current == ancestor { return true; }
            let Some(node) = self.nodes.get(current) else { return false; };
            if node.parent == NO_SLOT { return false; }
            current = node.parent as usize;
        }
    }

    fn resolve(&self, handle: DocumentHandle) -> Option<&Node> {
        if handle.document_id != self.id { return None; }
        let node = self.nodes.get(handle.slot as usize)?;
        (node.live && node.generation == handle.generation).then_some(node)
    }

    fn handle(&self, slot: u32) -> DocumentHandle {
        DocumentHandle { document_id: self.id, slot, generation: self.nodes[slot as usize].generation }
    }
}

    count.checked_mul(size_of::<T>())

#[test]
fn foreign_wrong_generation_and_deleted_handles_are_rejected() {
    let mut first = parse_document(SOURCE).unwrap();
    let second = parse_document(SOURCE).unwrap();
    let root = first.root().unwrap();
    let group = first.first_child(root).unwrap();
    let rectangle = first.first_child(group).unwrap();
    let unknown = first.next_sibling(rectangle).unwrap();
    let path = first.first_child(unknown).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(second.tag_name(root), None);
    assert_eq!(first.tag_name(crate::DocumentHandle { slot: u32::MAX, ..root }), None);
    assert_eq!(first.tag_name(crate::DocumentHandle { generation: 0, ..root }), None);
    assert_eq!(first.tag_name(crate::DocumentHandle { generation: root.generation + 1, ..root }), None);
    assert!(first.remove_subtree(group));
    assert_eq!(first.live_node_count(), 2);
    for stale in [group, rectangle, unknown, path] {
        assert_eq!(first.tag_name(stale), None);
        assert_eq!(first.source_span(stale), None);
        assert_eq!(first.parent(stale), None);

    assert_eq!(first.first_child(root).map(|handle| first.tag_name(handle)), Some(Some(&b"circle"[..])));

    assert_eq!(first.root(), None);
    assert_eq!(first.node_at(0), None);

#[test]
fn comments_doctypes_unicode_and_unknown_raw_metadata_remain_in_source() {
    let source = b"<?xml version='1.0'?><!-- note --><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY local 'raw'>]><svg x:unknown='v&' title='\xc3\xa9'><x:thing/></svg>";
    let model = parse_document(source).expect("supported document constructs");
    assert_eq!(model.node_count(), 2);
    let root = model.root().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(model.attribute_at(root, 0), Some((&b"x:unknown"[..], &b"v&"[..])));
    assert_eq!(model.attribute_at(root, 1), Some((&b"title"[..], &b"\xc3\xa9"[..])));
    assert_eq!(model.tag_name(model.first_child(root).unwrap()), Some(&b"x:thing"[..]));

    assert_eq!(&source[span.offset..span.offset + span.length], b"<svg x:unknown='v&' title='\xc3\xa9'><x:thing/></svg>");

}

#[test]
fn parse_errors_keep_xml_categories_and_offsets() {
    let mismatch = parse_document(b"<svg><g></svg>").unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(mismatch.error, DocumentError::Parse);
    assert_eq!(mismatch.diagnostic.category, XmlError::MismatchedTag);
    assert_eq!(mismatch.diagnostic.offset, 8);

    let invalid_utf8 = parse_document(b"<svg>\xff</svg>").unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(invalid_utf8.error, DocumentError::Parse);
    assert_eq!(invalid_utf8.diagnostic.category, XmlError::InvalidUtf8);
    assert_eq!(invalid_utf8.diagnostic.offset, 5);

    let invalid_character = parse_document(b"<svg>\0</svg>").unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(invalid_character.error, DocumentError::Parse);
    assert_eq!(invalid_character.diagnostic.category, XmlError::InvalidCharacter);
    assert_eq!(invalid_character.diagnostic.offset, 5);

    let duplicate = parse_document(b"<svg a='1' a='2'/>").unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(duplicate.error, DocumentError::Parse);
    assert_eq!(duplicate.diagnostic.category, XmlError::DuplicateAttribute);
    assert_eq!(duplicate.diagnostic.offset, 11);
}

#[test]
fn input_depth_and_actual_token_storage_limits_map_without_success_hooks() {
    let mut oversized = Vec::new();
    oversized.try_reserve_exact(vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1).unwrap();
    oversized.resize(vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1, b' ');
    let too_large = parse_document(&oversized).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(too_large.error, DocumentError::Limit);
    assert_eq!(too_large.diagnostic.category, XmlError::InputLimit);
    assert_eq!(too_large.diagnostic.offset, vexel_xml::MAX_INPUT_BYTES);

    let mut deep = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..=256 { deep.extend_from_slice(b"<x>"); }
    for _ in 0..=256 { deep.extend_from_slice(b"</x>"); }
    let depth_error = parse_document(&deep).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(depth_error.error, DocumentError::Limit);
    assert_eq!(depth_error.diagnostic.category, XmlError::DepthLimit);
    assert_eq!(depth_error.diagnostic.offset, 256 * 3);

    let at_capacity = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg/>", size_of::<XmlToken>()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(at_capacity.node_count(), 1);
    let partial_byte_capacity = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg/>", size_of::<XmlToken>() * 2 - 1).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(partial_byte_capacity.node_count(), 1);
    let exhausted = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg><a/><b/></svg>", size_of::<XmlToken>() * 3).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(exhausted.error, DocumentError::ResourceExhausted);
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.category, XmlError::OutputExhausted);
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.offset, 13);
    let below_one_token = parse_document_with_storage(b"<svg/>", size_of::<XmlToken>() - 1).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(below_one_token.error, DocumentError::ResourceExhausted);
}

#[test]
fn production_token_storage_cap_matches_original_boundary_case() {
    let token_capacity = (64 * 1024 * 1024) / size_of::<XmlToken>();
    assert!(token_capacity < crate::model::MAX_NODES);
    let child_bytes = token_capacity.checked_mul(4).unwrap();
    let total_bytes = 5usize.checked_add(child_bytes).unwrap().checked_add(6).unwrap();
    let mut source = Vec::new();
    source.try_reserve_exact(total_bytes).unwrap();
    source.extend_from_slice(b"<svg>");
    for _ in 0..token_capacity { source.extend_from_slice(b"<a/>"); }
    source.extend_from_slice(b"</svg>");
    let exhausted = parse_document(&source).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(exhausted.error, DocumentError::ResourceExhausted);
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.category, XmlError::OutputExhausted);
    let expected_offset = 5 + (token_capacity - 1) * 4;
    assert_eq!(exhausted.diagnostic.offset, expected_offset);
}

#[test]
fn id_exhaustion_seam_never_wraps_or_allocates_reserved_values() {
    let mut normal = DocumentIdAllocator::starting_at(41);
    assert_eq!(normal.allocate(), Some(41));
    assert_eq!(normal.allocate(), Some(42));
    let mut zero = DocumentIdAllocator::starting_at(0);
    assert_eq!(zero.allocate(), None);
    assert_eq!(zero.allocate(), None);
    let mut max = DocumentIdAllocator::starting_at(u64::MAX);
    assert_eq!(max.allocate(), None);
    assert_eq!(max.allocate(), None);
    let mut before_max = DocumentIdAllocator::starting_at(u64::MAX - 1);
    assert_eq!(before_max.allocate(), Some(u64::MAX - 1));
    assert_eq!(before_max.allocate(), None);
}

#[test]
fn source_span_value_has_checked_plain_byte_coordinates() {
    let span = DocumentSourceSpan { offset: 3, length: 4 };
    assert_eq!(span.offset, 3);
    assert_eq!(span.length, 4);
}

#[test]
fn stable_error_names_match_the_legacy_model_contract() {
    assert_eq!(DocumentError::InvalidArgument.as_str(), "invalid_argument");
    assert_eq!(DocumentError::Parse.as_str(), "parse");
    assert_eq!(DocumentError::Limit.as_str(), "limit");
    assert_eq!(DocumentError::ResourceExhausted.as_str(), "resource_exhausted");
    assert_eq!(DocumentError::OutOfMemory.as_str(), "out_of_memory");
    assert_eq!(DocumentError::IdExhausted.as_str(), "id_exhausted");
}
